# Nestwright

Home-design game: 2D plan ↔ live 3D, interiors, terrain, co-op for two. Spec: `docs/DESIGN.md`.
Electron + Vite + React + three.js + zustand/immer, TypeScript strict.

- `src/model/` is pure (no three, React, DOM) and owns every rule about the house. Test it there.
- Every mutation goes through `useStore.getState().apply(label, recipe)`; undo/redo and co-op
  sync are built on the immer patches it records. Never mutate the project another way.
- `src/model/types.ts` is the save-file schema. Changing a field needs a migration in
  `src/io/migrate.ts` and a bump of `PROJECT_VERSION`.
- All base-game 3D assets are procedural (built in code). Do not add third-party models,
  textures or fonts without a licence note in `docs/ASSETS.md`.
- Original game: never copy names, text, UI look or assets from any existing game.

## Verify

```bash
npm ci
npm run typecheck
npm run lint
npm test
npm run build
```

All five must exit 0. For anything visible, also run `npm run dev` and check it in the browser.

## Ship

Merge to `main`, then tag `vX.Y.Z` and push the tag. Locally on the Mac:
`npm run dist:mac` builds `release/Nestwright-<ver>-arm64.dmg` and the `.app`;
`scripts/install-mac.sh` copies the `.app` into `~/Applications`, and the dmg is attached to the
GitHub release with `gh release create vX.Y.Z release/*.dmg`. No Steam upload yet.

## Live check

```bash
gh release view "$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)" --json assets --jq '.assets[].name'
defaults read ~/Applications/Nestwright.app/Contents/Info.plist CFBundleShortVersionString
```

Then launch `~/Applications/Nestwright.app` and screenshot the running window.
